findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: convert_program, qec_decode, write_circuit · Private data: estimate_resources, list_targets, show_target, qec_learn, write_circuit · Public sink: compile_qasm, estimate_resources · Destructive: run_quantum_circuit, run_quantum_set, dry_run_quantum_job, get_quantum_job, verify_quantum_receipt, critique_qasm, convert_program, estimate_resources, run_on_target, qec_code, pulse_schedule, pulse_check, build_algorithm, dequant_lowrank, dequant_recommend, dequant_regress, run_landscape, run_qudit, solve_ising, run_wasmq, check_quantum_program, grade_quantum_program, write_circuit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: convert_program, qec_decode, write_circuit · Private data: estimate_resources, list_targets, show_target, qec_learn, write_circuit · Public sink: compile_qasm, estimate_resources · Destructive: run_quantum_circuit, run_quantum_set, dry_run_quantum_job, get_quantum_job, verify_quantum_receipt, critique_qasm, convert_program, estimate_resources, run_on_target, qec_code, pulse_schedule, pulse_check, build_algorithm, dequant_lowrank, dequant_recommend, dequant_regress, run_landscape, run_qudit, solve_ising, run_wasmq, check_quantum_program, grade_quantum_program, write_circuit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
